units.source_text: 一对孪生姐妹，如果在同一个家庭里，受到同样的抚育，可能会难于分清谁是谁。

en.t: If twin sisters were raised in the same family and brought up in the same way, it might be hard to tell which was which.

units.source_text: 可是，千重子和苗子过着截然不同的生活，在不同的环境中成长。

en.t: But Chieko and Naeko lived completely different lives and grew up in different surroundings.

units.source_text: 苗子心想，这个青年说不定是个近视眼。

en.t: Naeko thought to herself that this young man might perhaps be nearsighted.
